summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs with coordinates computed by removing the padding offset; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter patch generator; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with NotImplementedError for missing len; math import replaced with numpy ceil; PatchDataset docstring uses float); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst adds a PatchIter autodoc section; tests/test_grid_dataset.py adds TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, and an extra test_missing_len. Not verified by execution. The pinned two-worker and single-process values in test_loading_array depend on RNG ordering and may need checking if they fail. Remaining long lines in utils.py predate this change.
